# Security patterns (CloudAI-X)

Patterns for auth, authorization, secrets, encryption, CORS and rate limiting.

- Source: https://github.com/CloudAI-X/claude-workflow-v2
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CloudAI-X/claude-workflow-v2/main/skills/security-patterns/SKILL.md
- Author: CloudAI-X
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/security-patterns-cloudai-x-e8c41d36

Gives Claude implementation patterns for common security work: JWT and session auth, OAuth and OIDC, API keys, role-based and resource-level authorization, password hashing, secrets management and rotation, encryption in transit and at rest, CORS, rate limiting, security headers and input validation. It starts with a checklist to track and ends with a summary of common anti-patterns.

**Try asking:**
- "Add JWT auth with refresh tokens to this Express API"
- "Review how we store secrets and suggest a safer setup"
- "Set up rate limiting and security headers for our public endpoints"
